shots.transition_other: first frame of the video (no incoming shot); the frame is dimmed, i.e. the start of a fade up from dark
shots.typography: Native product UI text only: clean sans-serif (Atlassian UI font, low-confidence guess), regular/semibold weights, sentence case, default tracking; no overlay titles

shots.focal_element: The 'All Ideas' table: the new idea row being created and then the Fields side panel, Create a field form and idea detail Insights tab
on_screen_text: Add a quick summary of your idea and press enter
For some links, Jira Product Discovery can fetch more data you can use to prioritize ideas
shots.typography: Native product UI text only: sans-serif (Atlassian UI font, low-confidence guess), semibold page titles ('All Ideas', 'Onboarding templates'), regular body, sentence case, default tracking; no added captions or kinetic type
shots.what_happens: Long continuous narrated screen recording with digital punch-ins: from the full browser (0-2 s) it crops in to the table (about 2-15 s) while the presenter clicks 'Create an idea', types 'Add dark mode' (w15-w26) and sets Goal and Effort/Impact ratings (w27-w46); it reframes back out to the full browser as the Fields panel opens and fields are toggled off (w53-w64), a new field 'competitive differentiator' of type Slider is created and dragged per row (w65-w113); it then opens the 'Onboarding templates' idea and crops in again on its Insights tab, clicking 'Create an insight' and 'Paste a link' (w114-w158). A cursor drives all actions; the dropdown and side panel cast soft shadows.
shots.build_rebuild: Play the screen capture full-bleed and keyframe a CSS scale/translate crop (about 1.0 to 1.2) onto the active UI region at each narration step, easing between framings while the real cursor performs the clicks.
